name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a shockland that unlocks a hand card, when no basic reaches it
intent: Review item 3's fallback: once open-fetch-unlocks was narrowed to unlocks_by_basic_search (never cracking a fetch for nothing when the library holds no reachable basic), a hand fetch whose own search can reach an unlock only through a non-basic land - a shockland the library holds, no basic - needed a play of its own, or that unlock would go begging entirely. Plays a fetch from hand and cracks it for whatever library land unlocks some other hand card, paying life for both the fetch's own find (when it is itself a shock) and, if the found land also enters only untapped_if_paid, that land's own life cost too - strictly the most expensive of the fetch family, so it stands down whenever anything cheaper covers the same unlock: open-land-unlocks (a free untapped land), open-shock-unlocks (a hand shockland already reaches the unlock directly, one payment instead of two), and open-fetch-unlocks (the fetch can reach a basic instead, free). Same fetch-selection prefer as open-fetch-unlocks (a fetch whose other search target is Plains, dimir-frog's dead colour) and the same untapped-and-can-actually-reach-it restriction on the crack source, reading the broader unlocks_by_search since this play exists precisely for the fetch that cannot reach a basic. Its own choose_cards pick still prefers a basic first as a defensive no-op (the true condition already guarantees none is reachable, so this never actually resolves to one) then a shockland, paying life. Stands down at 7 life or less, once the library is down to 5 cards or fewer, and entirely against boros-aggro, boros-energy and ur-cutter-prowess - paying two life costs (the fetch's and the shock's) against the format's fast aggressive decks is never worth it; those archetypes get no fetch-for-an-unlock play once open-fetch-unlocks-basic's own basic search comes up empty, the same call open-fetch-unlocks and open-shock-unlocks already make. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
